mechanism_narrative: A increase in GDP signals a strong economy, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances when GDP is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment signals a strong labor market, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances when payroll employment is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts and a decrease in unemployment rate signal a strong economy, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances when housing starts are increasing and unemployment rate is decreasing.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate and an increase in GDP signal an easing monetary cycle and a strong economy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0 and GDP is above 11000 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production signals a strong economy, leading to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances when industrial production is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate and an increase in retail sales signal a strong labor market and high consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances when unemployment rate is decreasing and retail sales are increasing.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary cycle, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when FEDFUNDS is above 4.5 (t-test p > 0.05).
